title: Fix residual light in scene-off flashlight renders
objective: Make orbit render mode with scene lighting disabled produce near-black frames when the co-located flashlight is not spawned, while preserving softened co-located flashlight falloff when it is spawned.
instructions: Start from the completed validation output at examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_soft_falloff_validation: scene_off_flashlight_off is visibly lit even though spawn_flashlight=false, so residual environment/renderer light remains.

Investigate why scene-off isolation leaves residual light. The render log shows scene light components disabled but scene_light_isolation console commands had applied=false. Check whether ExecuteConsoleCommand invocation/targeting is wrong, whether exposure/tonemapper/postprocess/unlit fallback is contributing, or whether baked/static lighting/emissive materials need to be suppressed.

Implement the smallest robust fix in the flashlight orbit code path so scene_off_flashlight_off renders near-black and scene_off_flashlight_on is lit primarily by the co-located light with smooth falloff, not a hard circular mask.

Preserve the current softened flashlight controls: intensity 1200, attenuation 650, inner cone 2, outer cone 60, source radius 12, soft source radius 80, indirect lighting intensity 0 unless you find a better default and document why.
Add/update unit tests or script-level tests for any helper behavior changed, especially console command application reporting or scene-off isolation metadata.
Do not commit. Do not push. Leave visual validation to Tower/Experimenter after code tests pass.
expected_outputs: Code changes that make scene-off isolation actually disable residual scene/environment lighting.
definition_of_done: scene_off_flashlight_off should be expected to render near-black under validation, not the currently bright cafeteria.
scene_off_flashlight_on should keep softened co-located light behavior without hard circular aperture appearance.
